T1158.long: To prevent normal users from accidentally changing special files on a system, most operating systems have the concept of a ‘hidden’ file. These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

\pard\sa60\sl312\slmult1\f0\fs20\lang1049 ------------ AV VOICE CHANGER SOFTWARE GOLD 7.0 -------------\par
The next Generation Voice Changer Software for Windows\par
Copyright (C) 2011-201\f1\lang1033 9\f0\lang1049  AVSoft Corp. (VN) All Rights Reserved.\par
Thank you for purchasing Voice Changer Software GOLD 7.0 \par
(VCS GOLD) \endash  the most powerful real-time voice morphing tool. \par
This README file contains information about product's features \par
that were not covered in the manual, as well as the more \par
detailed information on the certain features already described \par
in the manual, the information on known issues, hardware issues \par
and useful tips.\par
CONTENT\par
1. A few things you should know\par
2. Functional peculiarities\par
3. What's new\par
4. Features\par
5. License\par
6. How to uninstall\par
7. Known issues\par
8. Quick tips to get started\par
1) A Few Things You Should Know\par
- You may install this version in a different folder than \par
where you installed the previous version.\par
- This version of VCS GOLD performs better on computers with \par
fast processors and high-quality sound cards. Make sure you \par
have the latest version of DirectX and the latest drivers for \par
your sound card installed.\par
- At the end of this document, you will see a Protection \par
Number; save it somewhere because you will need it for \par
future upgrades.\par
2) Functional Peculiarities\par
- VCS GOLD uses its installation folder as default folder \par
to store all user settings. \par
- You can save the settings for the Equalizer and load them \par
at any time you need.\par
- Automatic loading of suitable settings for different \par
streams based on the stream rate parameters.\par
- VCS GOLD has nickvoices that include pitch/timbre/\par
advanced tune, equalizer and effects settings along with \par
settings for different streams. \par
- Selecting several effects at a time with the possibility \par
of grouping effects by category name.\par
- All the effects are grouped by categories, composing a \par
comfortable tree structure to work with.\par
- You can save selected effects to an external file so \par
that next time you can easily restore them by just \par
clicking "Load" button. \par
- "Reset" buttons to clear all settings.\par
- VCS GOLD has a built-in update manager. As long as VCS GOLD\par
has been launched, update manager starts seeking for updates. \par
If a new update is found, user will be prompted to download \par
it. Autoupdate feature can be switched off but user can start \par
update manager manually at any time.\par
- VCS GOLD is equipped with Stream Settings pane to make \par
it easier for a user to shift stream types.\par
- VCS GOLD has a built-in Voice Comparator - you can \par
morph your voice into the voices of famous artists and \par
singers.\par
- VCS GOLD has a "Launch VCS GOLD on Windows startup" \par
option.\par
- VCS GOLD has a "Select microphone on start up" option. \par
If this option is enabled, VCS GOLD selects microphone \par
and adjusts its optimum volume level in system mixer.\par
3) What's New \par
In this version 7.0:\par
- Negative Feedback filter: It allows you to eliminate the \par
electronic noise of self-induction which could appear when \par
your microphone is close to your speakers.\par
- Non-human nickvoices: they allow you to have a nice \par
opportunity to use any non-human voices as if you are lion, \par
bird, bear etc. You may use 8 groups of non-human voices \par
which are available in VCS GOLD.\par
- Virtual-Audio-Driver (VAD) mode is giving possibility to \par
change stream which you choose in Application combo-box.\par
- HotKey\par
- New ready-to-use parody voice packages\par
- New ready-to-use comparator voices\par
- Windows Vista 32/64, XP 32/64 support\par
- Improved interface\par
- Improved Parody\par
4) Features\par
- Changes in real time the voice, either from a microphone, \par
CD, line-in, or auxiliary input, into hundreds of high-\par
quality female and male voices, animal, musical and fiction \par
sounds.\par
- Morphs in real time the WaveOut and DirectX streams.\par
- Has a small pack of ready-to-use audio effects and \par
nickvoices.\par
- Compatible with voice chat rooms, voice instant messengers, \par
audio & video conferencing, and PC-to-phone programs. You can \par
disguise your voice to be anonymous on the Net.\par
- Compatible with the standard sound recorders, sound \par
players, CD and Karaoke players. With AV VCS GOLD, you can edit \par
various voices, sound files, sound effects for your audio & \par
video clips and movies, you can morph songs or MP3 files and \par
create your own albums.\par
- Voice output can be customized by setting the desired \par
equalization.\par
- Along with the pitch algorithm, an additional timbre \par
shifting algorithm helps you change your voice into a \par
comprehensive range of high-quality new natural voices \par
controlling the "age" and "gender" of the voice output.\par
- VCS GOLD can intercept and change not only the recording but \par
also the playback and DirectX audio streams. You can morph \par
sound files, for example MP3 files played on a sound player \par
installed on your system.\par
- You can add effects from one hundred and forty of plug-in \par
ready-to-use audio effects to a real-time voice stream from \par
a microphone to a sound file, an MP3 composition, or a CD \par
track played back on a sound player or CD player.\par
- A combination of pitch/timbre, effects and equalization \par
settings is used for creating new nickvoices that can be \par
saved for future use. \par
- VCS GOLD has its own sound Recorder which makes it easy for you \par
to record and save in wave format your conversations, morphed \par
voice messages, as well as modified songs.\par
- VCS GOLD has a built-in Voice Comparator - you can morph your \par
voice into the voices of famous artists and singers.\par
- VCS GOLD can automatically generate names for new recordings and \par
save them in the folder that you have selected.\par
- VCS GOLD has a built-in sound Player - to play back the recorded \par
in VCS GOLD Recorder data.\par
- In the default skin, the pitch and timbre settings are \par
graph-represented allowing easier tuning.\par
5) License\par
Please read carefully the "License.txt" file. The license will \par
terminate automatically if you violate any of the provisions \par
of the Agreement. On termination, you must destroy all copies \par
of Voice Changer Software 7.0.\par
6) How to Uninstall \par
To uninstall VCS GOLD 7.0 Silver, start Windows Explorer, open the \par
folder where VCS GOLD was installed and then double-click the \par
UNINSTALL.EXE file. You can also go to Start - Programs \endash  \par
Voice Changer Software - Uninstall. Still another way is to \par
go to Control Panel, double-click Add or Remove Programs, \par
click AV Voice Changer Software 7.0, and then click Change/\par
Remove.\par
7) Known Issues\par
- Supply of this product does not convey a license or imply \par
any right to distribute content created with this product in \par
revenue-generating broadcast systems (terrestrial, satellite, \par
cable and/or other distribution channels), streaming \par
applications (via Internet, intranets and/or other networks), \par
other content distribution systems (pay-radio or audio-on-\par
demand applications and the like) or on physical media \par
(compact discs, digital versatile discs, semiconductor chips, \par
hard drives, memory cards and the like). An independent \par
license for such use is required. For details, please visit \par
{{\field{\*\fldinst{HYPERLINK http://mp3licensing.com/ }}{\fldrslt{http://mp3licensing.com/\ul0\cf0}}}}\f0\fs20\par
- This product includes technology owned by Microsoft \par
Corporation and cannot be used or distributed without a \par
license from Microsoft Licensing, Inc.\par
8) Quick Tips to Get Started\par
- Make sure your microphone and speakers are working properly. \par
Double-click the VCS GOLD 7.0 icon. Be sure to turn theVCS GOLD power on \par
and speak into the microphone, adjusting Voice Morpher \par
parameters. You should hear a modified voice that you won't \par
recognize.\par
- Change the position of the "Pitch-Timbre" pointer in the \par
"Voice Morpher" module or simply select a nickvoice by \par
clicking the "Nickvoices" menu button. \par
- Click the "Advanced" button and the "Advanced Effects" \par
Panel will appear. Choose any module and try any settings. \par
- On the "Equalizer" panel, click "Presets," and then try \par
presets one by one to hear how much they smooth out your \par
modified voice.\par
- Click the "Effects" button, select an effect, and listen \par
to your modified voice.\par
- The quality of the voice output also depends on the Mode \par
and Sample Rate attributes. You may set them in the "Stream \par
Settings" pane on the main panel.\par
- Should you have any questions, click "Help" to read the \par
"Help Topics," or visit our Web site\par
({{\field{\*\fldinst{HYPERLINK http://www.audio4fun.com/ }}{\fldrslt{http://www.audio4fun.com/\ul0\cf0}}}}\f0\fs20 ) to check out the updated FAQ section.\par
